text:
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks for the great questions in today's all-hands — starting a thread for follow-ups on performance reviews, comp changes, and manager next steps. I'll drop a short checklist and timelines below.

Sam (Eng Manager): Awesome, thanks. Quick Q — when is the final calibration packet due?

Aisha (People Ops): Final packet deadline is 2025-04-04 EOD PT. Please use the shared spreadsheet and upload signed manager summaries to the HR portal by then.

Jordan (IC): If someone is getting a leveling change, is the new band effective retroactively to the start of the review period, or from the publish date?

Dana (HR): Leveling/promotions are effective the publish date unless explicitly approved for retroactive pay. Retroactive adjustments require business justification + sign-off from Finance.

Leo (Finance): Quick add: retroactive increases >$5k need VP finance approval and will be queued into the next payroll cycle. Plan accordingly.

Sam (Eng Manager): Is there a recommended rubric for writing manager comments? Want to keep it consistent across teams.

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — use this simple format in the manager summary: 1) Context (scope/impact), 2) Evidence (3 examples), 3) Recommendation (level, comp band, target comp). Keep it <400 words. We'll anonymize for calibration.

hr-bot: :calendar: Calibration meeting scheduled: 2025-04-10 09:00-12:00 PT (Zoom link in calendar invite). Prep docs auto-attached to the event.

Jordan (IC): How are comp bands shifting this cycle? Will ranges move or just midpoints?

Dana (HR): We expect mostly midpoint adjustments (~3% uplift) for market movement, but some bands may be widened for scarce roles. Final band changes will be announced the day before publish.

Sam (Eng Manager): Any guidance on promotion cadence? I have one IC who's borderline between L4/L5.

Aisha (People Ops): Promotion cadence unchanged — managers should nominate when readiness criteria are met. Use the promotion rubric in the toolkit. If borderline, include a clear development plan and recommended effective date.

Jordan (IC): If someone wants to appeal, what's the process/timeline?

Dana (HR): Appeals accepted within 14 days of publish. Submit via the HR form, we triage within 7 business days and respond with next steps (re-review or clarify rationale).

Sam (Eng Manager): Manager checklist would be super helpful.

Aisha (People Ops): Manager checklist (copy/paste into your notes):
- Complete rating + comments in the review system by 2025-04-01 (manager draft)
- Upload signed manager summary PDF to HR portal by 2025-04-04
- Confirm calibration attendees and proxies by 2025-04-07
- Review comp guidance doc + proposed band moves (we'll email by 2025-04-03)
- For promotions, attach promotion rubric + 3 examples of impact
- Flag any retroactive pay requests to People Ops by 2025-04-02

Leo (Finance): Also check for any off-cycle hires or adjustments in your headcount plan that might affect available comp budget.

Sam (Eng Manager): Perfect, thanks. Can People Ops share a short template for manager summaries?

Aisha (People Ops): Yup — we'll post the template in #people-ops-resources and email a copy to all managers by EOD today.

Jordan (IC): Thanks — extremely helpful. One last Q: will there be calibration notes visible to managers after the meeting?

Dana (HR): Managers will get calibration outcomes and anonymized notes. We do not share individual reviewer comments.

Aisha (People Ops): Closing note: if you're a manager and need a 1:1 prep session, book with People Ops office hours (link in the calendar). Tag me if you have urgent cases. :thumbsup:
